directed_review.reproduction_overlay_driver:
import json,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile
# Run via scripts/test-remote.sh in a fresh synthetic PG18. No repository edits.
# Load review_probe_source from this evidence JSON before starting the remote run,
# because the existing remote sync intentionally excludes docs/evidence.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="rai-review-overlay-") as d:
    original=pathlib.Path("integration/training_test.go").resolve()
    replacement=pathlib.Path(d)/"training_test.go"
    replacement.write_text(original.read_text()+review_probe_source)
    overlay=pathlib.Path(d)/"overlay.json"
    overlay.write_text(json.dumps({"Replace":{str(original):str(replacement)}}))
    result=subprocess.run(["go","test","-overlay",str(overlay),"-count=1","-tags=integration","-run","^TestFullReview","-v","-timeout=10m","./integration"])
    raise SystemExit(result.returncode)

commands.name: dependency-and-backup-guards
command:
set -e
printf "REVIEW_GO_DEPS_PACKAGES="
go list -deps ./... | wc -l
go mod verify
python3 ../../scripts/check-boundaries.py
if command -v sqlc >/dev/null; then
 sqlc version
 python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib,pathlib,subprocess
paths=sorted(pathlib.Path("internal/storage/postgres/dbgen").glob("*.go"));before={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths};subprocess.run(["sqlc","generate"],check=True);after={str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths};assert before==after;print("REVIEW_SQLC_IDENTICAL=PASS")
PY
else
 printf "REVIEW_SQLC=NOT_AVAILABLE\n"
fi
bash ../../scripts/test-p7-backup-guards.sh
